sentences.text: The evidence does not show any pre-payment charge stated in the Key Facts Statement, so I cannot confirm that it matches the home loan agreement.
The home loan agreement shows a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding in one version.
A separate in-force copy of the home loan agreement shows a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding, so the agreement evidence itself is inconsistent.

missing.searched: Reviewed the KFS preamble and the KFS-related definitions/rules, but no KFS clause showing a pre-payment charge amount or rate was provided.
